The theorem computes the entire single-variable formula algebra in a canonical family, provides a uniform depth-two constructive normal form and a provably sharp depth threshold, not an arbitrary slice or simple negative instance. This explicit invariant supports meaningful comparison with multiple variables and other accessibility structures. Limits and source risks are acknowledged.
